campuses.name: Knight Campus
campuses.notes: Largest campus, all in one big building on 205 acres off Routes 95 and 295. It has One Stop, a library, the Tutoring and Writing Centers, IT Help Desk walk-in help, the Bobby Hackett Theater and an art gallery.

campuses.name: Flanagan Campus
campuses.notes: One building made of three connected modules on 300 acres. It has One Stop, a library, a tutoring center, an art gallery, an athletics field house and a bookstore.

campuses.name: Liston Campus
campuses.notes: Providence campus on the city's south side. It has One Stop (Room 1150), a library, a tutoring center, a bookstore and a 250-seat auditorium.

campuses.name: Newport County Campus
campuses.address: One John H. Chafee Blvd., Newport, RI 02840
campuses.notes: Campus in Newport's North End. It has One Stop (Room 150), a library, and tutoring and writing help inside the library (Rooms 251-252).

campuses.name: Westerly Education Center
campuses.notes: Satellite campus offering credit courses for southern RI and eastern CT, plus workforce training such as the Electric Boat maritime trades programs.

campuses.name: Woonsocket Education Center
campuses.notes: Satellite campus offering credit courses, workforce training and teen driver ed for northern RI and the Blackstone Valley.

offices.name: One Stop Student Services
offices.does: Your first stop for admissions, financial aid, billing, registration, transcripts and enrollment checks. It has offices on all four main campuses, and you can use any of them.

offices.name: Admissions
offices.does: Helps with applying to CCRI, next steps for new students, Early College for high schoolers and international students.

offices.name: Financial Aid
offices.does: Helps with the FAFSA, grants, loans, scholarships, student jobs and emergency aid.

offices.name: Records (Registrar)
offices.does: Keeps academic records and handles registration, withdrawals, transcripts, graduation applications and enrollment verification.

offices.name: Bursar's Office (Student Accounts)
offices.does: Handles tuition bills, payments, payment plans, refunds and the waivers for seniors and unemployed Rhode Islanders.

offices.name: Advising Center
offices.does: Helps you plan your classes and program, transfer, and Degree Works. Offers walk-in sessions (virtual and on campus) and appointments.
offices.hours: Walk-in session dates and times change; see the Advising page

offices.name: Disability Accessibility for Students (DAS)
offices.does: Arranges accommodations for students with disabilities in classes and for the Accuplacer placement test.

offices.name: Veteran Services Office
offices.does: Helps veterans, service members and their dependents use VA education benefits at CCRI.

offices.name: Library
offices.does: Libraries on all four main campuses with research help and study rooms. Live chat and text reference at (401) 235-4290.
offices.hours: Usually Mon-Thu 8am-8pm, Fri 8am-4pm, Sat 10am-2pm, closed Sun (holiday hours differ)

offices.name: Tutoring Center
offices.does: Free in-person and online tutoring and academic coaching on all four main campuses. Brainfuse online tutoring is open after hours.
offices.hours: Mon-Fri 8am-4pm (Newport: Mon, Tue, Thu 8am-4pm; Wed 8am-8pm; Fri 8am-1pm)

offices.name: Writing Center
offices.does: Free help with papers in person on all four main campuses or online by Zoom.
offices.hours: Knight Mon-Fri 8am-4pm; Flanagan and Liston Mon and Wed-Fri 8am-4pm, Tue 10am-6pm; Newport varies

offices.name: IT Help Desk
offices.does: Help with your CCRI username, password, myCCRI, email, Blackboard and Wi-Fi. Walk-in help is at Knight Campus Suite 2113.

offices.name: Campus Police
offices.does: CCRI's police department. Call for emergencies, routine matters, safety escorts, lost items and door access. Non-emergency and escort line: (401) 825-2109. TDD: (401) 851-1619.

offices.name: Campus Store (Bookstore)
offices.does: Barnes & Noble College runs the stores at Knight, Flanagan and Liston. They sell textbooks, access codes, supplies, CCRI gear and RIPTA bus passes, and accept financial aid at the start of each semester.

offices.name: Workforce Partnerships (non-credit training)
offices.does: Short-term non-credit job training (CNA, CNC manufacturing, CPR and more), adult education and English classes, teen driver ed and motorcycle training. Spanish line: (401) 455-6019.

offices.name: Personal Counseling and Wellness
offices.does: Free, short-term, confidential counseling for students. After hours, students can call TELUS Health at (866) 743-7732. In a mental health crisis, call or text 988.

offices.name: Rhode Island Promise
offices.does: Free tuition for an associate degree for eligible Rhode Islanders who enroll right after high school or a GED. You must complete the FAFSA, stay enrolled and keep a 2.5 GPA. One Stop answers questions.

offices.name: Benefits Hub (basic needs)
offices.does: Help with food, housing, bills and other basic needs, run with United Way of RI at Knight Campus. The CCRI grocery gift cards are all given out for now.
offices.hours: In person Tue 12pm-5pm, Fri 10am-3pm; virtual every weekday

offices.name: Dean of Students
offices.does: Student conduct, the student handbook, academic policies and reporting concerns.

notes: Academic calendar dates come from the data behind the calendar on ccri.edu/calendar/academic/ (Modern Campus feed). Some deadlines are stored as midnight-to-midnight ranges, so check end dates against the page.
Fall 2026 finals: the academic calendar says Dec. 15-18, but an entry on the general events calendar says Dec. 14-17. This file uses the academic calendar.
The 2026-12-28 entry just says 'Classes begin'. It is the Winter session start (Winter ends 2027-01-15). The holiday on 2027-01-18 says only 'Holiday (no classes)'; MLK Day is inferred from the date.
Commencement 2027-05-11 is on the academic calendar without a time or place.
Event times were converted from UTC to Eastern time. Event URLs use the calendar's #event-details/<id> route; the route is from the calendar code and was not checked in a browser.
The Sound of Music dates (Nov. 19-22) come from the theatre Upcoming Shows page, which gives no year. A Sept. 2026 CCRI news story places the show in late November 2026.
No concerts or music events were on CCRI's calendars for the next 30 days. There were no open houses on the calendar besides the Virtual Fall Open House on Nov. 12 (linked from the homepage).
Financial Aid phone: the FA contact page says (401) 825-2468, while the main Contact CCRI page sends Financial Aid to One Stop at (401) 825-2003.
Admissions hours: the Admissions contact page says Mon-Fri 8am-4pm, but the One Stop hours page says Fridays start at 9:15am.

Workforce: the main contact page gives (401) 825-1214 for Driver's Ed and transportation, but the Workforce contact page lists (401) 825-2003 for transportation and (401) 825-1214 for workforce and adult ed.
No phone number posted for: Records, Advising, DAS (only individual coordinators have numbers), the Bookstore, the Westerly and Woonsocket centers, or the Benefits Hub.
Hours not posted for: IT Help Desk, Campus Police, Bookstore (bncollege.com blocked automated access), DAS and Veteran Services.
Benefits Hub room is listed as both Knight Room 1220 (Student Union) and Room 0022 on the same page. The only contact is a United Way coordinator's email.
No current CCRI food pantry page was found on ccri.edu. The 2019 pantry news is outdated, and the Benefits Hub is the current basic-needs office.
Library hours were read from ccri.libcal.com for Nov. 9-Dec. 13, 2026. Holiday weeks differ (for example, Knight and Liston close Nov. 27).
Counseling has no Newport office phone listed; the Lincoln number is (401) 333-7053 and Providence is (401) 455-6010.
CCRI's campuses page lists four main campuses and two satellite education centers. No others are listed.
